description: Environment variable names consumed by the g8e Operator and CLI.

ConsensusID.description: Consensus ID for governance posture (doctrine, consensus, notary)

ConsensusURL.description: Consensus URL for governance posture (doctrine, consensus, notary)

VaultDir.description: Override for the vault directory path

VaultKey.description: Override for the vault key file path

VaultRequireUnlock.description: When set to 'true', requires vault unlock before gateway start

OperatorSessionID.description: In-memory operator session ID set by deploy script after enrollment; never persisted to config

ClientCert.description: Path to the operator client certificate for MCP stdio connections

ClientKey.description: Path to the operator client key for MCP stdio connections

CABundle.description: Path to the CA trust bundle for MCP stdio connections

GatewayURL.description: Override for the gateway URL used by MCP stdio; defaults to https://g8e.local:8443/mcp

AppID.description: Application SPIFFE ID for delegated agent runs

AppCert.description: Path to the delegated application certificate for agent runs

AppKey.description: Path to the delegated application key for agent runs

DataDir.description: Override for the data directory; used in test configurations

ProjectRoot.description: Override for project root directory; deprecated, paths now resolved by walking up from CWD
